# openwrt_uci_section (Resource)

Manages an OpenWrt UCI section and its key/value options.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Name of the UCI config file (without /etc/config/ prefix), e.g. 'network'.
- `type` (String) UCI section type, e.g. 'interface'.

### Optional

- `name` (String) UCI section name. If omitted, an anonymous section is created and its name is returned.
- `options` (Map of String) Map of UCI options for this section.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: <config>/<section_name>.
